notes.title: Post Launch Patch 1.2 + Future roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hello hammer wielders!!

I am here to tell you about patch 1.2 as well as a brief overview of the short term roadmap for Mystic Hammer and what to expect now that it has launched.  

Short term roadmap
- New abilities to unlock in the Tower Runs at higher waves
- More achievements with bonuses attached.
- Changing Tower Runs post wave 30-50 to start increasing mob density.
- More descriptions on some hidden hotkeys:  
*  In current patch, selecting a unit and hitting "R" will automatically upgrade them.
* Selecting a unit and hitting "S" will automatically sell them.
* Holding down CTRL will show red and green areas so you know where you can place units if the screen gets messy.

Patch 1.2 Notes + Launch patch
Added Dispel to the game.  You can unlock this in Tower Run.  It will remove detrimental effects.
Fixed a severe bug where level 5 wouldn't let you click the crafting tutorial.
Fixed an issue where scythe was invisible on mac.
FIxed an issue where hammer was invisible on mac.
Added hotkeys "S" for Sell and "R" for Upgrade.
Many more balance tweaks on the 50 campaign levels as well as all bosses.
Ascending is now down to 50 resources from 100.
Slow and Freeze now show as "Immune" when hitting a boss.
Fixed up Damage To Player to be more reasonable on some higher level enemies.
Updated sound effects for Flying Monster.
Added sound effect for Cactus Kid.
Fixed Cactus Kid's hitbox.
Added sound for Sand Bum.
Fixed Sand bum animation and attack speed.
Fire Elemental Sounds added.
Desert peeper now has sound effects.
Lowered gold cost of Lightning Mage, Paladin, Ninja, Shapeshifter.
You can now go to crafting screen and click "Back button" and it will take you to the right level.
Fixed an exploit where you could move levels forward, even though they wouldn't save.
Mushroom kid got a bit of a nerf to HP.
Fixed up some text on tutorials.
Cutscene music change pre lvl 18
Fixed a bug where skeleton wouldn't attack again after resurrecting.
Fixed some screen formatting issues.
 Fixed boss speeds.
Fire elemental looks and acts more reasonable! (He still does the "Single Ladies" dance tho)
Balancing dragon a bit.
Fixed bug with dragon damage - thereby also fixing falling boulder damage
Fixed bug where dragon head was coming off the body!
Fixed screen freeze when dragon fire breeds Fire Elementals.
Cleaned up Forest cutscene.

I hope you are all enjoying the game.  Thank you SO MUCH for your support!  If you are liking what you are playing, please leave a Review as it helps so much <3

notes.title: Patch 91 is here, a week before launch!
notes.notes:
Absolutely massive pre-launch patch!

Hey everyone.  Thank you SO MUCH for all of the support in the Steam Autumn Festival!  It was so great seeing you all there and be able to show off Mystic Hammer.  

The game will be releasing Oct 23rd (Next Friday!)

Check out the insane amount of patch notes below for version 91.  But first, a video:

Check out this epic boss battle demonstration!  Wishlist the game now to play on launch day and fight back!
[previewyoutube=YWMJ2rTwwaw;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, check out the new Paladin unit if you missed him!
[previewyoutube=q8_hSIV1K7M;full][/previewyoutube]

Version 91
ADDITIONS

[olist]
 Added DOZENS of new levels, enemies, combat mechanics
 Added a crafting tutorial
 Game now has hotkeys 1-6 for defenders and Q,W, and E for abilities.
 Tower Run mode has now been added to the game
 - You start with 1k gold.
 - How far will you push?  Unlimited waves.  Every 5 levels saves your progress and loot.
 - Enemies now scale up in Tower runs based on how high the wave is.
 - Units will gradually phase into tower run mode in the beginning so as not to overwhelm the player with high level mobs in wave 1-15 or so.
 Added a mysterious (and difficult) boss!
 - Mysterious boss now casts lightning correctly and changes damage amount!
 - Mysterious Boss now has different spell casting effects for each type of spell he casts.
 - New Mysterious boss now teleports around the screen.
 - Mystery boss now casts meteor and "DOOM"
 The knight can now ascend to a new class:  Paladin.
 - The paladin has a ton of health.
 - The paladin inflicts burn on hit up to 3 stacks.
 - The paladin can heal himself for 50% of his attack damage.
 Added another boss to the game
 - This one will jump around the screen.
 - Barrels WILL be thrown at your units with a surprise critter inside!
 Added Fire Elemental enemy
 - Fire Elementals now shoot meteors from the sky!
 - Fire Elementals also inflict burn on hit.
 Added Desert Peper enemy
 - Desert peeper burrows into the ground and pops up to shoot fireballs at you!
 Added Frogmen to the game.
 Added Frogment warrior to the game.
 Added Frogmen Sorcerer to the game.
 - Will case curse on you, a debuff that increases damage you take by X%/stack.
 Added Sand Bum to the game.
 Added new Snow biome.
 Added new Desert biome.
 Added new Cave biome.
 Added windowed option in option popup.
 Added resolution option in option popup.
 Added new message if you try to ascend a unit you already ascended.
 Finally got around to adding 20+ Steam achievements that are now linked!
 New Achievements hooked up for Tower Runs 10,20,30,40,50.
 Added beavers to the forest.
 Added Cactus Kid enemy to the desert.
 Added Minotaur Armsman to the snow wasteland.
 - He can hit multiple targets in melee range.
 Added Minotaur Charger to the snow wasteland.
 - He will charge the battlefield quickly and do massive damage to both units in front of him!
 Added new music to the entire game composed by Damon Tattersfield
 Added the ShapeShifter unit to the game!
 - Shapehshifter can transform into a tanky beaver to take damage.
 - Can also shift back to human and cast regenerate on other units.
 Added the regenerate skill to the game!
 Added curse ability to the game!
 Changed all cutscene dialogues to use the new parchment instead of speech bubble.
 Added new story chapters and updated some existing text.
 Added new cutscenes.
 Added juciness to Next Wave and Level Lost popups.
[/olist]

FIXES

[olist]
 Fixed a long standing bug in which sometimes melee characters would fight when too far away after losing range.
 Optimized the game to not do so many melee calculations unecessarily.
 Fixed lighting for new layers in all levels.
 Fixes issues with lightning on projectiles.
 Fixed critical issue where sometimes cutscenes would save over your last level progress!
 Fixed an issue where the XP for chapter 1 would run over the UI.
 Fixed a bug where Paladin was healing and Shapeshifter cassting regen in cutscene!
 Fixed a bug where shapeshifter would re-shift before dying.
 Fixed icon sizes of status ailments on Fire Archer.
 Fixed a bug where Necromancers chant would be full screen.
 Fixed a bug where Tribal Spirit Shaman and Frogman Sorc would cast spells without targets instead of walking forward.
 Fixed up HP bars and Status icons on all units.
 Fixed a bug where enemies could sometimes cause you to lose health out of no where.
 Fixed issues with Crafting tutorial.
 Fixed a bug where enemies were counting damage multiple times to the poor player.
 Fixed it so the Forest boss is in front of defenders at all times.
 Potentially fixed a collision issue with new beavers and their units they bite!
 Finally fixed an issue where melee units were attacking things outside of their range.
 Fixed a bug where defenders still weren't attacking tribal spirit shaman.
 Cyclops can no longer spawn too high off the screen.
 Fixed borders on Level Selector Popup and Tower Run Wave Selector popup.
 Fixed a bug where sound could cause the level to get broken midway through.
 Fixed formatting of Conversion buttons.
 Fixed an issue where conversion amounts would disappear when clicking the button a few times.
 Fixed a bug where conversions werenn't saving.
 Fixed a bug on mac osx where chain and lock werent showing for locked abilities.
 Forcing the graveyard boss to show up for work again!
 Fixed a bug where lightning mage sometimes didn't chain her lightning.
 Fixed a bug where boss wasn't spawning again!
 Fixed bug on home screen with continue / start button.
 Fixed a bug where after restarting a level, it actually got harder because achievement bonuses didn't kick in!
 Fixed a bug where you can sometime spawn units outside of the intended area.
 FIxed some issues with rain sounds in the graveyard.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes characters would randomly be lit up and others were darker.
 Cyclops will no longer hit things above his head!
 Fixed a bug where cutscenes would sometimes  roll back the last level you achieved if you watched older ones again.
 Fixed bug where tutorial for flying monster would show up at level complete screen.
 Fixed up boulder thrown from Cyclops to not hit twice.
 Fixed issue where casting slow spell would overwrite root/frozen.
[/olist]

IMPROVEMENTS

[olist]
 Added scythe to necro.
 Added skull particle effects.
 Renamed cutscenes to better describe the context.
 Did an ordering overhaul on the game so that units will no longer have their hair rise above enemies!
 Lowered the music volume on the main menu.
 Made the options popup a cleaner more consistent UI.
 Nerfed level 20 a bit in frequency of spawns.
 Nerfed the mushroom kid's attack speed (too quickly stacking poison!)
 Added unique sounds for Merchant.
 Added unique sounds for Thief.
 Added unique sounds for Shapeshifter.
 Many new sounds for different units to avoid repetition.
 Changed Mage frostbolt sound.
 Combat refactor to allow units to hit multiple targets.
 Regen now unlocks during cutscene.
 Added new portrait for paladin.
 Updated snow music to be less jolly.
 Boss fights now have separate music.
 Added back correct music to crafting screen.
 Cutscene dialogue now bounces a bit.
 Fixed up Forest cutscene dialogue positions.
 Priestess gained a gold discount and higher base healing.
 Updated game engine for more efficiencies.
 When item resources spawn, they will now be automatically counted even if you can't hover over it in time.
 Revamped popups with new UI look.
 Boss fight at the end of demo is harder now.
 More balance post level 11.
 Readjusted waves to make level 1-5 more smooth and give more time to prepare.
 Crafting now unlocks at level 5.
 Ascending cost down to 100 from 250
 Fixed up some UI elements to make it consistent.
 Fixed an issue where lights in the tower run weren't flickering.
 Cyclops boss now picks up boulder with new animation and throws one.
 Cyclops boss no longer does long distance melee attacks on units that his boulder hits.
 Fixed more text sizes after engine update.
 Thief has had his health reduced as he was way too tanky for the damage he deals out.
 Paladin's sword now has...FLAMES!
 Upgraded the look of the paladin.
 Thieves now steal gold as they are supposed to!
 Fixed a bug where tribal shamans and thieves would be at a melee standoff and thief couldnt hit back.
 Nerfed Chain Lightning Mages' damage (sorry it was out of control jumping twice!)
 Increased damage of Fire arrow archers.
 Slightly increased damage over time of burning effect.
 Hotkeys now properly cancel the previous Ability.
 Ability targetting now shows the icon if the ability you are using from hammer.
 Algorithm adjusted for Unlimited Tower Run Mode.
 All units in game now can spawn in tower Run mode.
 Links for social media now work on all platforms.
 Made quick, credits, options buttons smaller.
 Add spacer control to main screen so everything is evenly spaced.
 Added more female sounds.
 Added sounds for the knight.
 Some variety over all with sounds.
 Changed sound of player level up to be less annoying.
 Added a new placement system that will validate placement and make sure no two units can exist on the same square.
 Decreased the damage that enemies do to players when they get through.
 Level 13 now has a longer preparation time.
 Reading the story text now will save automatically so you can return to the level you were at without re reading story.
 Added a few seconds more of prep time to level 17
 Skeletal Archer got hit with the nerf bat.
 You can now interact with the scrollbar after the credits are done rolling instead of needing to hold down the mouse on the background.
[/olist]

notes.title: Developer LIVE STREAM AMA + Full version Play
notes.notes: Hello again friends!  Thank you for checking out and wishlisting "Mystic Hammer"!  Releasing next week.  I'm going to do another short notice Stream tonight!

notes.title: Update 69: Meet Tribal Spirits!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!  It's time to celebrate!  Much good is happening to Mystic Hammer recently.  Please consider giving it a wishlist today!  It will be worth it!

We hit 200 followers on twitter, hurray!

But here's the big one.  I know I always say huge patch.  This one is massive.  Over 100 changes.  here are some of them.  See below!

The new Tribal Shaman:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/081e9cfbfe71aff54f11a653db488a3d015e0583.jpg

New UI Dialogue:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/6b1ed0ef1cd7297ceb23109940cd8001cb40e0ff.png

Additions


 Added new levels
 Added updated Dialogue UI instead of the white speech bubbles.
 Got an animation to fade in when each dialogue opens before bouncing.
 Introducing the Forest's Tribal Spirit!  This little guy likes pointy ends, so be careful!
 Introducing the Tribal Spirit Shaman!  Purple magic explosions.  Need I say more?
 In crafting, resources now turn green when you have enough to upgrade the unit and red when you do not.
 Updated proper video for unlocking full version in demo version.
 Achievements that give unit health will now add to unit health percentage.
 Achievements that give unit attack will now add to unit attack percentage.
 Added custom build menu to make deploying easier.
 Have new way of building demo specific verison! (Be excited!)
 Added cost and resource icon under ascended panel in crafting.
 Added new sound to level loss and win.
 Added "non regulated" sounds to manager like UI etc.
 Added new sound for achievement Popup and unlocks.
 Sound Manager now acts as a traffic officer for multiple sounds coming in and puts appropriate delays between them, thus taking down considerably the amount of noise spam.
 Added attacker difficuly tier system which is responsible to adding to loot rolls making harder enemies drop more quantities of loot.
 Added crafting button to level complete screen.
 New grid system to show green where you can place units.  Show by holding down ctrl
 Added random tips after you lose on how to make yourself more powerful.
 Added new mage animation so she looks less bored with her job.


Fixes


 Fixed a bug where you couldn't return to level 19 after cutscene unless you beat it.
 Fixed a bug where Necro boss wouldn't spawn.
 Crafting screen now shows base health instead of health with the upgrades.
 Fixed a bug where health wasn't being calculated correctly and was multiplying.
 Fixed a bug where health showed up as 0 in the UI after a character is unlocked.
 Tribal Shaman now makes a "heehee" sound before shooting it's magic bolt.
 Tribal Spirit Shaman apparently shooting purple laser beams!  Is that in the lore?
 Tribal shaman now has a sound when it fires it's magic bolt (okay, laser)
 Added purple explosion from Shaman attacks
 Fixed an issue where it wasn't always showing red and green properly on the crafting screen.
 Fixed a bug where health can sometimes be inconsistent with upgrades and not take into account achievements properly.
 Fixed a bug where level 11 didn't show units as injured.
 Fixed "Level up" vfx coming from units and going over the popup.
 Fixed all issues related to achievement popups, sounds, level completed popup.
 The "Level up" vfx shows up again.
 Fixed issue where priestess was healing unlimited on one unit!
 Fixed issue with XP bar VFX.
 Fixed a bug where health bonuses would double for units.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes values wouldn't be correct after crafting.
 Player level achievements now giving bonuses properly.
 Health gain percentage achievement works for player now.
 Energy gain percentage achievement works for player now.
 Started Tracking Player level in stats.
 Readjusted achievement awards to all be percentage based and count after upgrades.
 FINALLY fixed a bug where invalid shaders would cause enemies to turn purple.
 Fixed all spawn animations to be bouncy again.
 Fixed rain collision so it no longer goes in front of UI.
 Heal ability text now formatted correctly when unlocked.
 Fixed audio issue where clicking a wood button would sound like it was hit twice.
 Abilities no longer take your energy if you cancel them!
 Fixed issue where lightning wasn't making sounds.
 Added boulder toss sound back to Giant Cyclops.
 Fixed a bug where "Need more gold" wasn't showing up on the unit level upgrade.
 You will no longer hear the upgrade sound on a failed upgrade.
 Fixed a critical glitch where all characters were too large and backwards in cutscenes!
 Archer T2 and Mage T2 sounds are back.
 Fixed a bug where some losing popups looked different for some levels.
 Fixed an issue with text offset on menu buttons.
 Took out incorrect turorial from level 13
 Fixed a bug where freezing caused burning effect?? lol
 Fixed a bug where sometimes restarting levels would freeze.
 Clicking on units now shows the unit by your cursor.
 Fixed up the UI on the loss screen and added a button to crafting.
 Fixed Priestess heal animation.


Improvements


 Toned down Tribal Spirit Shamans.
 Updated credits for fonts
 Fixed up some missing "Black bars" for resolutions.
 Flying monster now flies in front of units.
 Added plain parchment background to popup dialogue.
 Added arrow to bottom of new dialogue.
 Converted slow from frost bolt to be a status ailment.
 Slow now lasts 8 seconds and then returns to normal speed.
 Slow is set at 60%
 Nerfed level 6
 Unified speech bubble throughout the game so that the style can be updated.
 Made the following speech bubble changes.
 Reduced dialogue bouncing because it was too much.
 Made it so that demo can no longer proceed past certain level and got rid of a loophole.
 Credit screen now waits until you close the demo popup.
 Added custom build menu to make deploying easier.
 Updated teleport chant on cutscene.
 Disabled overkill wind sound from levels 11 to 14
 Critical hits now cost 20 resources as intended instead of 2.
 You can now hit escape during a Cutscene and use the options and pause.
 Greatly decreased energy required for healing ability.
 Slightly increased energy required for freeze ability.
 Greatly reduced the damage of Skeletal Archer.
 Updated and fixed the size and font of the level up icon.
 All units received a new spawn animation to add some juiciness.
 Cleaned up "Options" font.

notes.title: Brand new Trailer! Massive new update!
notes.notes:
Trailer

This is a massive update!  Getting another step closer to release.  Firstly, the new trailer for Mystic Hammer!

[previewyoutube=QrRtai7x0yM;full][/previewyoutube]

Onto showcasing some of the new stuff.  We have a new Mage in town.  The ascended version of the mage is the chain lightning mage.  She hurls lightning at the enemy which chains to another random evemy (even in a different lane!):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/527e7caea38042a13350944e7d857f4da3899fec.gif

Also, notice the indoor dungeon-looking setting.  This is the background for the unlimited Tower Runs feature.   This is a different experience each time.  Increasing in difficulty with each new wave.  Rewards and experience increasing as you ascend the steps of the tower.  Every 10 waves, it will save your progress so you don't have to start back at wave 1.

Stats and achievements?  We got you covered.  Steam achievements are now part of Mystic Hammer.  In addition to this, the in-game achievements give stat bonus rewards!  Another way to spec out your characters on the battlefield:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/94f469f0909c983efcffa5c0e9ddc489468a6284.gif

Lighting!  All environments now have some form of lighting.  Mage lightning glows, candles flicker, etc.  One example is to the story cutscene, that infamous portal now glows!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/91be98be49df2cfc1b70add9ce131015bb68e5b4.gif

Just to show how massive of an update this is, here are the patch notes for those curious.  See you in game soon!  Tell you friends so we can up our wishlist game and hit the ground running in a few months!

Update Notes


Additions


 Steam is now integrated with achievements.  Will be adding them as I go along!
 Added fire flickering effect to torches in tower level
 Light flickers from candles now ease in and out better.
 Lightning Mage now hits a second random target.
 If Chain lightning only has one attacker on the board, it will only strike once.
 Chain lightning will no longer branch to the same character twice on chance.
 Added Mage Tier 2.
 Ascended Mage now fires lightning bolt at an attacker.
 Added light effect to staff when bolt comes out.
 Lightning changes for Mage T2
 Lighting changes for archer's fire arrows.
 Added a post processing effect to lightning to have bloom effect and make things it zaps brighter!
 Added lighting to all backgrounds in game.
 Mage now chains between two targets and damage doubled.
 Lowered the arc of the lightning a bit.
 Added flame lighting effect to arrow!
 Ascended feature finally implemented!  Ascending a unit will add it to your bar and save.  While I originally planned 1k resource cost, it's currently set 	at 200 for testing.  Once loot droprate quanities get updated, I will likely revert to 1k
 Added description of unit you are going to upgrade and current description.
 Added portrait of the character you are upgrading to ascending screen in crafting.
 Added portrait to fire Archer.
 Wind and rain sound are now hooked into the volume controls.
 Achievements now popup in a new dialogue when unlocked in game.
 Multiple achievements can now poup during the same level completion.
 Units Placed and Abilities Used now counts towards achievement progress.
 Added achievements for player level, kill 100k enemies, kill 1 million enemies.
 Added icons for ability damage, unit attack damage, energy regen.
 Text and bonus icon on achievements will show as greyed out until achievement unlocked.
 Added achievement reward icon.
 Added steam achievement icon.
 Kill achievements and UI working now!
 Highest Ability dmg and Highest Unit Dmg now work.
 Credits screen is now complete.
 Updated Credits music.
 Screen now scrolls.
 Have different fonts and headings.
 When scrolling ends, you can scroll up or down freely
 New Achievement system is working.  Both loading / saving / looking up achievements.
 Energy now regenerates!  Currently, at a hard rate of 2% per 3 second, but stat to be added in the future!
 Stat Progress screen complete.  This screen will allow you to scroll through progress you have gone through in the game!
 Added the following to the stats page:

          Time played, Enemies Killed, EXP Gained, Units Placed, Abilities Used, Treasure Looted, Arcane Looted, Militia Looted, Total Deaths, Best Unit Dmg, Best Ability Dmg.

Fixes


 Stopped a secret level from loading at the end of the game instead of the credits (sorry guys :P)
 Fixed a bug where credits wouldn't load on some platforms.
 Fixed UI glitch when you are out of energy.
 Fixed an issue where the cursor was disappearing.
 Fixed an issue where defender menu was not appearing anymore.
 Fixed an issue where the battle setup screen would not allow assigning of abilities.
 Mushroom kid was causing havoc and only giving one EXP!  Upped it significantly.
 Fixed bug where Stats screen would sometimes not show for new player.
 Fixed a bug with energy regen that would eventually slow to a crawl mid-match.
 Fully fixed issues related to damage over time ailment.
 Stacks will stop disappearing.
 Enemies no longer randomly miss stacks.
 All timers will tick relative to when they should instead of round robin.
 Fixed a UI glitch with level 8 tutorial.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't sell defender sometimes.
 Fixed a bug where damage over time effects wouldn't kill enemies once the attacking unit is long gone.


Improvements


 Resources now light up so it's easier to spot in dark levels.
 Added some more color to text in story Chapter 1 and 2.
 Fixed the backpack icon as it was too large.
 Updated the font on "Need more gold", "Energy used", and "Crafting Mat Looted"
 Massive restructuring and removal of placeholder assets to be better aligned with credits.
 Increased base energy regeneration to 5% up from 2%.
 Re-did start screen UI.
 Added Stats button, Achievements button, Credit button.
 Swapped between New Game and Continue game now to make room.
 Changed mouse cursor.
 Added description to Poison for popup.
 Added some code to help support in the future if I decide to do multiple game saves.
 Added a new double check when files are saved.  It will attempt to load first to make sure that the new save would not be corrupted for any reason.  If that is the case, it simply will not overwrite the game data instead of corrupting a file.  Thankfully in the entire year, this has only happened once - but enough to warrant the safeguard!
 Right clicking the mouse or using two fingers to tap will finally cancel out of ability use.
 Added a new SoundManager to control sounds.
 Added a new sound for leveling up a unit.
 Added a new sound for selling a unit.
 More folder project organization.

notes.title: Crushing Covid with Update 51
notes.notes:
While it has been difficult with kids at home, daycare closed, and both me and my wife holding full time jobs: I have still been putting every minute I can into Mystic Hammer during this lockdown.  I want to assure you that the release will still continue in 2020!  

Patch 51 Notes

 Introducing Shielded Skeleton
- Heavy HP
- Really slow
 Introducing Skeletal Archer
- Can fire arrows at range.

Rebalanced level 16 with new units
New units yield higher XP, so get to farmin'!
Merchants now show the gold numbers they generate from their sales.

 Merchant Balance changes:
- Merchants now have a range they can get of gold when selling.
- Merchants now have sell speed.
- Merchants now have chance to get a great sale! (Critical!)

Dynamically changing icons now also happening on Crafting screen in upgrade and Ascend tab.
Updated Level up and Sell icons on in-game stat panel.
UI now updates with healing icon for Priestess stat, attack for damage dealers, and gold regen icon for merchants.
Updated icons in-game for stats to match crafting screen art style.
Critical hit heals now work in the UI.
Priestess now has her heal value based on an upgradeable stat.
Introducing: Critical heals!
Fixed spacing issues for resource conversion on crafting screen.
Added a "coming soon" label to Ascend.
Speed and Critical stats are now shown for selected units on the battlefield.
Fixed a bug where defender name wasn't showing for selected units on the battlefield. 
Critical hits UI is in!  Orange and says "Crit!"
Fixed an issue where damage wasn't always calculating correctly / fairly.
Refactored a bunch of damage dealing logic to make it easier to extend.
All units given 3% crit chance base before upgrades.  For now, Archer and Fire archer have 5%.
Critical hit is in! Critical hits will do 2x damage roll against an enemy. 
Attack speed is hooked up to crafting screen and working.  (For now, minimum is 100% speed and max speed is 200%).
Attack speed and heal speed working now for ranged units and healers.
Melee attack speed now implemented.

Shielded Skeleton blocking a nasty blow:

notes.title: Mega Patch 50 - Crafting, Art Overhaul, and more!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/36cbc922294fb0cf67210c07e50507ddc1bd5d52.png

The patch is here!  Version 50, a patch I worked very hard on over the past month or so.  I wanted to share my progress with you all.  Check out the patch notes below with 68 changes!  If you missed the recent blog post on the art overhaul, check it out here.  Lastly, be sure to check out the video where I showcase some of the features of patch 50, now available on closed beta.  Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=4Kb4YIo6uag;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch 50
Features / Additions

 Added Cost, Health, and attack unit stats to selection panel.  
 Changed health to increase as well as attack when a unit is upgraded mid-battle.
 Added fire arrow along with animation.
 Added impact for frostbolt spell when it hits target.
 Added Fire Archer Tier 2.
 Added arrow impact animation.
 Added fire arrow impact animation.
 Added new font for damage numbers.
 Attackers and Defenders will now fade away when they die.
 New death animation to go "poof"!
 Leveling up the archer in-game now creates the Fire Archer.
 Charactrers and abilities will now automatically add to your bar if you have an empty slot.
 Overhaul on the bottom bar in the UI to include all slots and a divider between Abilities.  Also larger buttons.
 Added new animation for the ruin ability AOE.
 Crafting screen UI overhaul with tabs!
 Battle Setup Screen UI overhaul with tabs! There are two tabs:  One for defenders and one for Abilities.  The defenders tab allows you to equip defenders on your bar as well as click on them to see their stats.  The abilities bar allows you to equip your abilities as well as view it's stats and description.
 Updated first chapter levels to use a brand new background art of outside the castle
 Battle Setup screen now unlocks at level 5 instead of level 13!
 Added a system so that players who go back to tutorial levels don't have their abilities or defenders re-arranged automatically.
 Defender Upgrades now load and save correctly!
 Attack upgrades now apply to in-game defenders.
 Health upgrades now also work inside the game!
 Properly assigned each defender a resource type to upgrade with.  Temporarily removed AttackSpeed and Critical hit rate until after patch.
 Stats now show their respective resource costs when upgrading.
 Highlighted the relevant resource when you select a unit.
 If you have enough resources, it will now deduct from your total and allow you to increase the stat.
 You can now hit reset to reset back to the page's initial status in case you are experimenting.
 When a particular stat is maxxed, the cost text will change to the word "MAX"

Improvements

 Introduced upgraded arrow graphics.
 Arrows now have an animation while in the air.
 Arrows move a bit slower now across the screen. (slight archer nerf)
 Introduced new Boulder graphic for Cyclops Boss.
 Level 15 had it's difficulty increased by adding more health.
 Added an extra wave on level 15.
 Slightly reduced 2nd boss prep time.
 Increase XP per bat kill slightly.
 Increased XP per Flying Monster by 1.
 Decreased First boss XP by 50% to reduce grinding him for XP too easily.
 Increased EXP amount of 2nd Boss.
 Frostbolt art has beeen updated.
 Frostbolt is now animated.
 Mage attack animation now fires more early to center the frostbolt.
 Damage on enemies will not be white.
 Damage on players will continue to be red.
 Changed animation for damage numbers.
 New damage text now moves with enemies.
 New fonts and more consistency throughout the screens.
 Improved font on Next Level Popup.
 Improvements on crafting screen ui.
 End of level font improvements and UI border.
 Fixed all button presses in the game regardless of size.
 Selecting a defender on the crafting screen is now 1 row with arrows to move left and right on the ascend tab.
 Updated coin animation and replaced Kill Counter Skull icon.
 Crafting screen now highlights the unit or ability you are trying to replace so you can see easier which you are replacing.
 Reduced the size of the game by about 40% by removing unecessary asset references.
 Selecting abilities on the Battle Setup Screen now shows a different frame to show which ability will be replaced.
 Updated button graphics on crafting screen as well as hid any windows that weren't relevant before selecting a defender to upgrade or ascend.

Fixes

 Fixed issue with tutorial highlighters on level 8
 Fixed flying monster's eye so that it doesn't pop out in front of other attackers!
 Start screen should now work better on multiple resolutions on multiple devices.
 Fixed crafting screen for multiple resolutions on multiple devices.
 Fixed padding issue on defender select on Crafting Screen.
 Fixed a bug on the crafting screen where it didn't allow you to select a unit and change your mind before selecting a unit to replace it with.  Switching to a different slot to replace is now possible making it less confusing.
 Fixed a bug where the popup UI after unlocking a unit or feature wasn't formatting correctly.
 Slime Monsters and Skeletons now dropp loot upon death.
 Fixed a bug on level 13 where you couldn't place units in the middle of the battlefield.
 Unused defender slots no longer show a cost.
 Fixed a bug where level 11 characters were telling you they were injured, but clearly they were lying!

Known Issues

 If you already started Mystic Hammer and have a save on mobile, you may not be able to see the ability on level 3 until you reach level 5 and beat it again.  If you aren't able to customize your bar correctly, you can reset your game data by going into Mystic Hammer android settings and deleting Cache and Data.  Then, the game will start over again and you can go through the recent new player experience.
 I realize the Merchant can be upgraded, but his attack goes from 0-0.  Use your judgement, don't try to give him attack for now :)
 Ascending feature is currently not enabled.


As always, check out the blog for more info.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/fd619152792024424ae8d3fa608af48b6810999c.png

Patch 45 Notes

– Introducing the Priestess
* If units do not have max health, she will heal them automatically.
* Currently, she will heal in the order that the units were placed.
* Multiple priestesses can heal different targets or focus heal the same. I may add randomness to the healing in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/9c36ddc99f086cf1fea02d577c8b930352bbb8f8.png
– Added Chapter 3
– Added Story Chapters as loadable levels in case you missed it.
– Priestess now unlocks and has stats popup.
– Added Level 16!
– Fixed up level 16 intro text and set waves.
– Fixed a bug where loading levels would always be 1 behind where it should have been.
– Added targetting icon for when you select a unit.
– Removed the two different cursor modes, you can now freely select units and also place them without changing mode.
– Selecting a unit will now open a Defender stat panel which shows stats and allows you to sell or upgrade the unit.
– Removed the old upgrade / sell defender panel window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36357052/3d298a91dfd0a5da3562a0b84067a5ded28a9a01.png

– Added new Unit upgrade button that is much larger and works better with mobile devices.
– Added new Unit Sell button that is much larger and works better with mobile devices.
– Added text to tell you how much gold you will gain for selling a selected unit.
– Added text to tell you how much gold to level up the unit. The text will turn red when you do not have enough gold.
– Re-did level 8 tutorial to show how to use new menu to upgrade and sell units.

For more information, see the blog.

notes.title: Happy New Year / Version 41
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 

2020 is going to be a fabulous year. Why is that? Mystic Hammer is going to release in 2020! I wanted to keep you updated on the progress from thee last post.  As you can see, I already tackled down a few items on the immediate list.  Here is patch 41 which I released today.  Stay tuned for more!

Version 41

 Revamped the ranged units attack system so that it will attempt to fire at what is alive in front of it rather than ensuring it is officially in it’s lane. (This will fix the bug where sometimes units stop firing at an enemy).
 Changed defender leveling system to now give defenders XP when they hit an enemy with both melee and projectiles. This will make it so that your units aren’t battling for the killing shot all the time!
 Level up Particle Effects!! Makes it obvious who to click when you want to pay to level a unit.
 Introducing the Necromancer
- Speaks a chant of an unknown language to case evil spells. (Voice added)
- Has an ability to raise the undead.
 Speech Bubble system introduced. (Not tutorial system).
 Speech Bubble can now have it’s text, color, and duration set.
 Necromancer sounds added.
 Skeleton sounds added.
 Fixed a bug where your health would drop out of no where causing unfairness!
 Added a system for speech audio and tagging.
 Added a system for specifying which lane a boss spawns in.
 Fixed a long standing bug where sometimes the level would not end. Now safeguards in place to ensure it ends when the timers are over and all enemies are defeated as it should be.
 Fixed a bug where something was not alive but still being asked to take life away. If the health ends up below 0, it will destroy the enemy.
 Fixed issue where sometimes resurrected units will become unhittable and walk through your defenders.
 Level 15 is added!
 Fixed bug where sometimes enemies wouldn’t spawn in lane. Fixed bug where slimes and Skeletons were not giving unit EXP correctly.
 Fixed a bug wheresometimes bosses would decide not to spawn at all! (Not so fast! 😉 )
 Fixed UI issue where Boss Wave wasn’t being labelled as such.


For more about this version and to see some screenshots of the new meanie in town, head over to the blog.
